test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: When was Jana Gana Mana officially adopted by the Constituent Assembly as the Indian National Anthem?
solution:
The correct answer is __**24 January, 1950**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Jana Gana Mana** was officially adopted as the Indian National Anthem by the Constituent Assembly on 24 January 1950.
 
• It was originally written in Bengali by **Rabindranath Tagore** and was first sung on 27 December 1911 at the Calcutta Session of the Indian National Congress.
 
• The anthem consists of the first stanza of the Brahmo hymn titled "**Bharoto Bhagyo Bidhata**" written by Tagore.
 
• It was translated into Hindi and the Hindi version was adopted as the national anthem.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rabindranath Tagore**

 
 
• Rabindranath Tagore was a polymath, poet, musician, and artist from India.
 
• He was the first non-European to win the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1913.
 
• Tagore's works include novels, short stories, songs, dance-dramas, and essays.
 
• He is also the author of the national anthem of Bangladesh, "Amar Shonar Bangla".
 
 
 
• **Constituent Assembly of India**
 
 
• The Constituent Assembly was established to draft the Constitution of India.
 
• It first met on 9 December 1946 and completed its work on 26 November 1949.
 
• Dr. B.R. Ambedkar was the chairman of the drafting committee of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The Constitution of India was adopted on 26 January 1950, making India a republic.
 
 
 
• **National Anthem**
 
 
• A national anthem is a patriotic musical composition that evokes and eulogizes the history, traditions, and struggles of its people.
 
• It is officially recognized by a nation's government as the official national song.
 
• National anthems are often played during national holidays, military and other civic ceremonies, and international sporting events.
